# Clarity Chat - Complete API Reference

> Clarity Chat is a production-ready React component library for building AI chat interfaces with 200+ components, 95+ hooks, streaming support, RAG, memory management, and enterprise features. Built with TypeScript, React 19, and Tailwind CSS.

This document contains comprehensive API documentation for Clarity Chat optimized for AI consumption. It includes full type signatures, all props, return values, code examples, and implementation guides.

**Version**: 2.0.0
**License**: MIT
**NPM**: @clarity-chat/react
**Repository**: https://github.com/clarity-ai/clarity-chat-components
**Documentation**: https://clarity-chat.dev

---

## Installation

### Package Installation

```bash
# npm
npm install @clarity-chat/react

# pnpm (recommended)
pnpm add @clarity-chat/react

# yarn
yarn add @clarity-chat/react

# bun
bun add @clarity-chat/react
```

**Peer Dependencies:**
- React 18.0.0+ or React 19.0.0+
- Tailwind CSS 3.4.0+

**Optional Packages:**
```bash
# Memory management
npm install @clarity-chat/memory

# Token optimization and cost reduction
npm install @clarity-chat/token-optimization

# All packages
npm install @clarity-chat/react @clarity-chat/memory @clarity-chat/token-optimization
```

### Framework-Specific Setup

#### Next.js 13+ (App Router)

```tsx
// app/layout.tsx
import '@clarity-chat/react/styles.css'

export default function RootLayout({ children }) {
  return (
    <html lang="en">
      <body>{children}</body>
    </html>
  )
}
```

#### Next.js 12 (Pages Router)

```tsx
// pages/_app.tsx
import '@clarity-chat/react/styles.css'
import type { AppProps } from 'next/app'

export default function App({ Component, pageProps }: AppProps) {
  return <Component {...pageProps} />
}
```

#### Vite

```tsx
// main.tsx
import '@clarity-chat/react/styles.css'
import React from 'react'
import ReactDOM from 'react-dom/client'
import App from './App'

ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(
  <React.StrictMode>
    <App />
  </React.StrictMode>
)
```

#### Remix

```tsx
// app/root.tsx
import clarityChatStyles from '@clarity-chat/react/styles.css'

export const links = () => [
  { rel: 'stylesheet', href: clarityChatStyles }
]
```

## Quick Start

### 3-Line Chat (Recommended)

The fastest way to get started with Clarity Chat. This single component provides a complete chat interface with streaming support.

```tsx
import { ClarityChatApp } from '@clarity-chat/react'

function App() {
  return <ClarityChatApp api="/api/chat" />
}
```

**What you get:**
- Full chat interface with message list and input
- Streaming response support
- Automatic error handling
- Loading states
- Responsive design
- Accessibility features (WCAG 2.1 AA)

### With Memory Enabled

Add conversation memory to retain context across messages:

```tsx
<ClarityChatApp
  api="/api/chat"
  features={{ memory: true }}
/>
```

**Memory features:**
- Automatic context retention
- Semantic search across conversation history
- Token budget management
- GDPR-compliant data handling

### Enterprise Preset

Pre-configured for enterprise use cases with security, compliance, and monitoring:

```tsx
<ClarityChatApp
  api="/api/chat"
  preset="enterprise"
/>
```

**Enterprise features:**
- Multi-tenant isolation
- Audit logging
- Role-based access control
- SSO integration ready
- Compliance monitoring

### Token Optimization Enabled

Reduce API costs by up to 70% with automatic optimization:

```tsx
<ClarityChatApp
  api="/api/chat"
  features={{
    tokenOptimization: true,
    memory: true
  }}
/>
```

**Optimization features:**
- Automatic compression
- Provider-native caching
- Smart model routing
- Cost tracking and budgeting

### Using the Hook

For more control, use the `useClarityChat` hook directly:

```tsx
import { useClarityChat } from '@clarity-chat/react'

function ChatComponent() {
  const { messages, append, isLoading, error } = useClarityChat({
    api: '/api/chat',
    memory: { enabled: true, strategy: 'vector-store' }
  })

  return (
    <div className="chat-container">
      <div className="messages">
        {messages.map(m => (
          <div key={m.id} className={`message ${m.role}`}>
            {m.content}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {error && <div className="error">{error.message}</div>}

      <button
        onClick={() => append({ role: 'user', content: 'Hello' })}
        disabled={isLoading}
      >
        {isLoading ? 'Sending...' : 'Send'}
      </button>
    </div>
  )
}
```

## Core Components

### ClarityChatApp

**Path**: /reference/components/clarity-chat-app
**Package**: @clarity-chat/react

The unified App API component - the recommended entry point for most applications. Provides a complete chat interface in a single component.

**Props:**

```typescript
interface ClarityChatAppProps {
  /** API endpoint URL (required) */
  api: string

  /** Preset configuration: 'default' | 'minimal' | 'enterprise' | 'developer' | 'creative' */
  preset?: ClarityAppPreset

  /** Feature flags */
  features?: ClarityFeatureFlags

  /** Memory configuration */
  memory?: MemoryConfig

  /** Token optimization configuration */
  tokenOptimization?: TokenOptimizationConfig

  /** Tools/function calling configuration */
  tools?: ToolsConfig

  /** RAG configuration */
  rag?: RAGConfig

  /** Safety configuration */
  safety?: SafetyConfig

  /** Observability configuration */
  observability?: ObservabilityConfig

  /** UI configuration */
  ui?: UIConfig

  /** Event callbacks */
  onEvent?: (event: ClarityEvent) => void

  /** Error handler */
  onError?: (error: Error) => void

  /** Custom className */
  className?: string

  /** Children for custom layouts */
  children?: React.ReactNode
}

interface ClarityFeatureFlags {
  memory?: boolean
  tokenOptimization?: boolean
  tools?: boolean
  rag?: boolean
  safety?: boolean
  observability?: boolean
}

type ClarityAppPreset =
  | 'default'      // Balanced features and performance
  | 'minimal'      // Lightweight, minimal UI
  | 'enterprise'   // Full features with security and compliance
  | 'developer'    // Developer-friendly with debugging tools
  | 'creative'     // Enhanced for creative writing
```

**Basic Usage:**

```tsx
import { ClarityChatApp } from '@clarity-chat/react'

export default function Page() {
  return (
    <ClarityChatApp
      api="/api/chat"
      preset="default"
    />
  )
}
```

**With Memory:**

```tsx
<ClarityChatApp
  api="/api/chat"
  features={{ memory: true }}
  memory={{
    strategy: 'vector-store',
    maxTokens: 8000,
    enabled: true
  }}
/>
```

**With Token Optimization:**

```tsx
<ClarityChatApp
  api="/api/chat"
  features={{ tokenOptimization: true }}
  tokenOptimization={{
    enabled: true,
    targetReduction: 0.5, // 50% reduction
    strategies: ['compression', 'caching', 'routing']
  }}
/>
```

**With Tools (Function Calling):**

```tsx
<ClarityChatApp
  api="/api/chat"
  features={{ tools: true }}
  tools={{
    definitions: [
      {
        name: 'search',
        description: 'Search the web',
        parameters: {
          type: 'object',
          properties: {
            query: { type: 'string' }
          }
        }
      }
    ]
  }}
/>
```

**Enterprise Configuration:**

```tsx
<ClarityChatApp
  api="/api/chat"
  preset="enterprise"
  features={{
    memory: true,
    tokenOptimization: true,
    safety: true,
    observability: true
  }}
  safety={{
    contentModeration: true,
    piiDetection: true,
    toxicityFiltering: true
  }}
  observability={{
    logging: true,
    metrics: true,
    tracing: true
  }}
  onEvent={(event) => {
    // Send to analytics
    console.log('Event:', event)
  }}
/>
```

### ClarityChat

**Path**: /reference/components/clarity-chat
**Package**: @clarity-chat/react

The all-in-one chat component with built-in streaming, memory, and theming. Legacy component, prefer `ClarityChatApp` for new projects.

**Props:**

```typescript
interface ClarityChatProps extends UseClarityChatOptions {
  /** API endpoint URL (required) */
  api: string

  /** Optional chat ID for persistence */
  chatId?: string

  /** Optional className for the chat container */
  className?: string

  /** Custom empty state */
  emptyState?: React.ReactNode

  /** Header configuration */
  header?: {
    show?: boolean
    title?: string
    subtitle?: string
    actions?: React.ReactNode
    showMessageCount?: boolean
  }

  /** Message action callbacks */
  messageActions?: {
    onCopy?: (id: string, content: string) => void
    onFeedback?: (messageId: string, type: 'up' | 'down', comment?: string) => void
    onEdit?: (messageId: string) => void
    onRegenerate?: (messageId: string) => void
    onDelete?: (messageId: string) => void
  }

  /** Prompt configuration */
  prompts?: {
    starterPrompts?: Array<{ text: string; category?: string }>
    enableSuggestions?: boolean
    maxSuggestions?: number
  }

  /** Rate limiting configuration */
  rateLimiting?: {
    enable?: boolean
    maxConcurrentRequests?: number
    maxQueueSize?: number
    showQueueStatus?: boolean
    onRequestQueued?: (position: number, estimatedWaitMs: number) => void
    onRateLimited?: (resetAt: number) => void
    onQueueFull?: () => void
  }

  /** Auto-scroll to bottom on new messages */
  autoScroll?: boolean

  /** Theme for the chat interface */
  theme?: string

  /** Show token counter in input */
  showTokenCounter?: boolean

  /** Show network status indicator */
  showNetworkStatus?: boolean

  /** Enable message operations (edit, delete, branch) */
  enableMessageOperations?: boolean

  /** Memory strategy for conversation context */
  memoryStrategy?: 'sliding-window' | 'semantic-chunks' | 'vector-store'

  /** Error handler */
  onError?: (error: Error, errorInfo?: React.ErrorInfo) => void
}
```

**Usage Example:**

```tsx
import { ClarityChat } from '@clarity-chat/react'

export default function ChatPage() {
  return (
    <ClarityChat
      api="/api/chat"
      header={{
        show: true,
        title: "AI Assistant",
        subtitle: "Powered by GPT-4",
        showMessageCount: true
      }}
      messageActions={{
        onFeedback: (id, type) => console.log('Feedback:', id, type),
        onRegenerate: (id) => console.log('Regenerate:', id)
      }}
      prompts={{
        starterPrompts: [
          { text: "What can you help me with?", category: "general" },
          { text: "Explain quantum computing", category: "technical" }
        ]
      }}
      autoScroll={true}
      theme="dark"
      showTokenCounter={true}
    />
  )
}
```

### ChatWindow

**Path**: /reference/components/chat-window
**Package**: @clarity-chat/react

Container component for chat messages with automatic scroll management and virtualization support.

**Props:**

```typescript
interface ChatWindowProps {
  /** Messages to display */
  messages: CoreMessage[]

  /** Scroll event callback */
  onScroll?: (event: React.UIEvent) => void

  /** Auto-scroll to bottom on new messages */
  autoScroll?: boolean

  /** Show scroll-to-bottom button */
  showScrollButton?: boolean

  /** Enable virtualization for large lists (recommended for >50 messages) */
  virtualized?: boolean

  /** Group consecutive messages by sender */
  groupMessages?: boolean

  /** Custom className */
  className?: string

  /** Custom message renderer */
  renderMessage?: (message: CoreMessage) => React.ReactNode

  /** Empty state content */
  emptyState?: React.ReactNode

  /** Loading state */
  isLoading?: boolean

  /** Error state */
  error?: Error | null
}
```

**Usage Example:**

```tsx
import { ChatWindow } from '@clarity-chat/react'

function MessageDisplay({ messages }) {
  return (
    <ChatWindow
      messages={messages}
      autoScroll={true}
      showScrollButton={true}
      virtualized={messages.length > 50}
      groupMessages={true}
      emptyState={
        <div className="empty-state">
          <h3>No messages yet</h3>
          <p>Start a conversation!</p>
        </div>
      }
    />
  )
}
```

**With Custom Renderer:**

```tsx
<ChatWindow
  messages={messages}
  renderMessage={(message) => (
    <div className="custom-message">
      <strong>{message.role}:</strong>
      <span>{message.content}</span>
      <small>{new Date(message.createdAt).toLocaleString()}</small>
    </div>
  )}
/>
```

### ChatInput

**Path**: /reference/components/chat-input
**Package**: @clarity-chat/react

User input component with multi-line support, attachments, voice input, and suggestions.

**Props:**

```typescript
interface ChatInputProps {
  /** Current input value */
  value: string

  /** Value change handler */
  onChange: (value: string) => void

  /** Submit handler */
  onSubmit: () => void

  /** Placeholder text */
  placeholder?: string

  /** Enable file attachments */
  attachments?: boolean

  /** Enable voice input (requires browser support) */
  voiceInput?: boolean

  /** Prompt suggestions */
  suggestions?: string[]

  /** Maximum input length */
  maxLength?: number

  /** Disabled state */
  disabled?: boolean

  /** Loading state */
  loading?: boolean

  /** Show token counter */
  showTokenCounter?: boolean

  /** Token count */
  tokenCount?: number

  /** Max tokens allowed */
  maxTokens?: number

  /** Custom className */
  className?: string

  /** Key press handler */
  onKeyPress?: (event: React.KeyboardEvent) => void

  /** File upload handler */
  onFileUpload?: (files: File[]) => void
}
```

**Basic Usage:**

```tsx
import { ChatInput } from '@clarity-chat/react'
import { useState } from 'react'

function ChatForm() {
  const [input, setInput] = useState('')

  return (
    <ChatInput
      value={input}
      onChange={setInput}
      onSubmit={() => {
        console.log('Submit:', input)
        setInput('')
      }}
      placeholder="Type a message..."
    />
  )
}
```

**With All Features:**

```tsx
<ChatInput
  value={input}
  onChange={setInput}
  onSubmit={handleSubmit}
  placeholder="Ask me anything..."
  attachments={true}
  voiceInput={true}
  suggestions={[
    "What is React?",
    "Explain hooks",
    "Show me an example"
  ]}
  maxLength={4000}
  showTokenCounter={true}
  tokenCount={tokenCount}
  maxTokens={4096}
  onFileUpload={(files) => {
    console.log('Files:', files)
  }}
/>
```

### Message

**Path**: /reference/components/message
**Package**: @clarity-chat/react

Individual message display component with markdown rendering, code highlighting, and action buttons.

**Props:**

```typescript
interface MessageProps {
  /** Message data */
  message: CoreMessage

  /** Message variant */
  variant?: 'default' | 'compact' | 'bubble'

  /** Show avatar */
  showAvatar?: boolean

  /** Show timestamp */
  showTimestamp?: boolean

  /** Available actions */
  actions?: Array<'copy' | 'edit' | 'delete' | 'regenerate' | 'branch'>

  /** Edit handler */
  onEdit?: (messageId: string) => void

  /** Delete handler */
  onDelete?: (messageId: string) => void

  /** Regenerate handler */
  onRegenerate?: (messageId: string) => void

  /** Branch handler (create conversation branch) */
  onBranch?: (messageId: string) => void

  /** Copy handler */
  onCopy?: (messageId: string, content: string) => void

  /** Custom className */
  className?: string

  /** Highlight search terms */
  searchHighlight?: string

  /** Show edit mode */
  isEditing?: boolean

  /** Show loading state */
  isLoading?: boolean
}
```

**Usage:**

```tsx
import { Message } from '@clarity-chat/react'

function MessageDisplay({ message }) {
  return (
    <Message
      message={message}
      variant="default"
      showAvatar={true}
      showTimestamp={true}
      actions={['copy', 'edit', 'delete', 'regenerate']}
      onEdit={(id) => console.log('Edit:', id)}
      onDelete={(id) => console.log('Delete:', id)}
      onRegenerate={(id) => console.log('Regenerate:', id)}
      onCopy={(id, content) => {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(content)
      }}
    />
  )
}
```

## Streaming Components

### StreamingMessage

**Path**: /reference/components/streaming-message
**Package**: @clarity-chat/react

Real-time streaming response display with character-by-character animation.

**Props:**

```typescript
interface StreamingMessageProps {
  /** Current content */
  content: string

  /** Whether currently streaming */
  isStreaming: boolean

  /** Streaming speed (characters per second) */
  streamingSpeed?: number

  /** Render mode: 'character' | 'word' | 'line' */
  renderMode?: 'character' | 'word' | 'line'

  /** Show cursor animation */
  showCursor?: boolean

  /** Cursor style */
  cursorStyle?: 'block' | 'underline' | 'pipe'

  /** Completion callback */
  onComplete?: () => void

  /** Chunk callback (fired for each chunk) */
  onChunk?: (chunk: string) => void

  /** Custom className */
  className?: string

  /** Enable markdown rendering */
  markdown?: boolean

  /** Enable code highlighting */
  codeHighlighting?: boolean
}
```

**Usage:**

```tsx
import { StreamingMessage } from '@clarity-chat/react'
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'

function StreamingDemo() {
  const [content, setContent] = useState('')
  const [isStreaming, setIsStreaming] = useState(true)

  useEffect(() => {
    const text = "This is a streaming message demonstration..."
    let index = 0

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      if (index < text.length) {
        setContent(text.slice(0, index + 1))
        index++
      } else {
        setIsStreaming(false)
        clearInterval(interval)
      }
    }, 50)

    return () => clearInterval(interval)
  }, [])

  return (
    <StreamingMessage
      content={content}
      isStreaming={isStreaming}
      streamingSpeed={20}
      renderMode="character"
      showCursor={true}
      cursorStyle="pipe"
      markdown={true}
      codeHighlighting={true}
      onComplete={() => console.log('Streaming complete!')}
      onChunk={(chunk) => console.log('Chunk:', chunk)}
    />
  )
}
```

---

### VirtualizedMessageList

**Path**: /reference/components/virtualized-message-list
**Package**: @clarity-chat/react

High-performance virtualized message list for handling thousands of messages efficiently.

**Props:**

```typescript
interface VirtualizedMessageListProps {
  /** Messages to display */
  messages: CoreMessage[]

  /** Item height (for fixed height items) */
  itemHeight?: number

  /** Enable dynamic height calculation */
  dynamicHeight?: boolean

  /** Overscan count (number of items to render outside viewport) */
  overscan?: number

  /** Scroll to bottom on mount */
  scrollToBottom?: boolean

  /** Auto-scroll on new messages */
  autoScroll?: boolean

  /** Custom message renderer */
  renderMessage?: (message: CoreMessage, index: number) => React.ReactNode

  /** Custom className */
  className?: string

  /** Loading state */
  isLoading?: boolean

  /** On scroll callback */
  onScroll?: (scrollTop: number, scrollHeight: number) => void
}
```

**Usage:**

```tsx
import { VirtualizedMessageList } from '@clarity-chat/react'

function LargeConversation({ messages }) {
  return (
    <VirtualizedMessageList
      messages={messages}
      itemHeight={80} // Fixed height for better performance
      overscan={5}
      scrollToBottom={true}
      autoScroll={true}
      renderMessage={(message, index) => (
        <div className="message-item">
          <strong>{message.role}:</strong>
          <p>{message.content}</p>
        </div>
      )}
    />
  )
}
```

**With Dynamic Heights:**

```tsx
<VirtualizedMessageList
  messages={messages}
  dynamicHeight={true} // Calculate heights dynamically
  overscan={3}
  scrollToBottom={true}
/>
```

## AI Components

### ChainOfThought

**Path**: /reference/components/chain-of-thought
**Package**: @clarity-chat/react

Step-by-step AI reasoning visualization component.

**Props:**

```typescript
interface ChainOfThoughtProps {
  /** Reasoning steps */
  steps: ChainOfThoughtStep[]

  /** Collapsed state */
  collapsed?: boolean

  /** Show confidence scores */
  showConfidence?: boolean

  /** Show execution time */
  showDuration?: boolean

  /** Step click handler */
  onStepClick?: (step: ChainOfThoughtStep) => void

  /** Variant: 'default' | 'compact' | 'detailed' */
  variant?: ChainOfThoughtVariant

  /** Custom className */
  className?: string

  /** Enable expand/collapse animation */
  animated?: boolean
}

interface ChainOfThoughtStep {
  id: string
  title: string
  content: string
  status: 'pending' | 'running' | 'completed' | 'error'
  confidence?: number // 0-1
  duration?: number // milliseconds
  children?: ChainOfThoughtStep[] // Nested steps
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>
}
```

**Usage:**

```tsx
import { ChainOfThought } from '@clarity-chat/react'

function ReasoningDisplay() {
  const steps = [
    {
      id: '1',
      title: 'Analyze Question',
      content: 'Breaking down the user query into components...',
      status: 'completed',
      confidence: 0.95,
      duration: 245
    },
    {
      id: '2',
      title: 'Search Knowledge Base',
      content: 'Searching vector store for relevant information...',
      status: 'completed',
      confidence: 0.87,
      duration: 892
    },
    {
      id: '3',
      title: 'Generate Response',
      content: 'Formulating answer based on retrieved context...',
      status: 'running',
      confidence: 0.92
    }
  ]

  return (
    <ChainOfThought
      steps={steps}
      collapsed={false}
      showConfidence={true}
      showDuration={true}
      variant="detailed"
      onStepClick={(step) => console.log('Clicked:', step)}
    />
  )
}
```

### ToolExecutionCard

**Path**: /reference/components/tool-execution-card
**Package**: @clarity-chat/react

Display tool/function call execution with input, output, and status.

**Props:**

```typescript
interface ToolExecutionCardProps {
  /** Tool execution data */
  tool: ToolExecution

  /** Expanded state */
  expanded?: boolean

  /** Toggle handler */
  onToggle?: () => void

  /** Show input parameters */
  showInput?: boolean

  /** Show output result */
  showOutput?: boolean

  /** Show execution time */
  showDuration?: boolean

  /** Retry handler */
  onRetry?: (toolId: string) => void

  /** Cancel handler (for pending/running) */
  onCancel?: (toolId: string) => void

  /** Custom className */
  className?: string

  /** Variant */
  variant?: 'default' | 'compact' | 'detailed'
}

interface ToolExecution {
  id: string
  name: string
  description?: string
  parameters?: Record<string, unknown>
  result?: unknown
  status: 'pending' | 'running' | 'completed' | 'error' | 'cancelled'
  startedAt?: Date
  completedAt?: Date
  error?: Error
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>
}
```

**Usage:**

```tsx
import { ToolExecutionCard } from '@clarity-chat/react'

function ToolDisplay() {
  const tool = {
    id: 'tool-1',
    name: 'search',
    description: 'Search the web',
    parameters: { query: 'React hooks tutorial' },
    result: { results: [...] },
    status: 'completed',
    startedAt: new Date('2024-01-20T10:00:00Z'),
    completedAt: new Date('2024-01-20T10:00:02Z')
  }

  return (
    <ToolExecutionCard
      tool={tool}
      expanded={true}
      showInput={true}
      showOutput={true}
      showDuration={true}
      variant="detailed"
      onRetry={(id) => console.log('Retry:', id)}
    />
  )
}
```

## Token Optimization Components

### TokenOptimizationDashboard

**Path**: /reference/components/token-optimization-dashboard
**Package**: @clarity-chat/react

Complete dashboard for token usage analytics, cost tracking, and optimization insights.

**Props:**

```typescript
interface TokenOptimizationDashboardProps {
  /** Token usage data */
  data: TokenUsageData

  /** Time range: '24h' | '7d' | '30d' | '90d' | 'all' */
  timeRange?: string

  /** Show cost projections */
  showCosts?: boolean

  /** Show optimization recommendations */
  showRecommendations?: boolean

  /** Show comparison with baseline */
  showComparison?: boolean

  /** Currency for cost display */
  currency?: string

  /** Custom className */
  className?: string

  /** Refresh interval (ms) */
  refreshInterval?: number

  /** On time range change */
  onTimeRangeChange?: (range: string) => void
}

interface TokenUsageData {
  totalTokens: number
  inputTokens: number
  outputTokens: number
  cachedTokens: number
  cost: {
    total: number
    input: number
    output: number
    cached: number
  }
  savings: {
    amount: number
    percentage: number
  }
  breakdown: {
    byModel: Record<string, number>
    byEndpoint: Record<string, number>
    byUser?: Record<string, number>
  }
  timeline: Array<{
    timestamp: Date
    tokens: number
    cost: number
  }>
  recommendations?: OptimizationRecommendation[]
}
```

**Usage:**

```tsx
import { TokenOptimizationDashboard } from '@clarity-chat/react'
import { useTokenData } from './hooks/useTokenData'

function TokenAnalytics() {
  const { data, loading } = useTokenData()

  if (loading) return <div>Loading...</div>

  return (
    <TokenOptimizationDashboard
      data={data}
      timeRange="7d"
      showCosts={true}
      showRecommendations={true}
      showComparison={true}
      currency="USD"
      refreshInterval={30000} // 30 seconds
      onTimeRangeChange={(range) => console.log('Range:', range)}
    />
  )
}
```

---

## Core Hooks

### useClarityChatApp

**Path**: /reference/hooks/use-clarity-chat-app
**Package**: @clarity-chat/react

Unified App API hook - the recommended hook for most applications. Provides complete chat functionality with memory, tools, and optimization.

**Options:**

```typescript
interface UseClarityChatAppOptions {
  /** API endpoint URL */
  api: string

  /** Preset configuration */
  preset?: ClarityAppPreset

  /** Feature flags */
  features?: ClarityFeatureFlags

  /** Memory configuration */
  memory?: MemoryConfig

  /** Token optimization configuration */
  tokenOptimization?: TokenOptimizationConfig

  /** Tools configuration */
  tools?: ToolsConfig

  /** RAG configuration */
  rag?: RAGConfig

  /** Safety configuration */
  safety?: SafetyConfig

  /** Initial messages */
  initialMessages?: CoreMessage[]

  /** Event callbacks */
  onEvent?: (event: ClarityEvent) => void

  /** Error handler */
  onError?: (error: Error) => void
}
```

**Return Type:**

```typescript
interface UseClarityChatAppReturn {
  // Core chat state
  messages: CoreMessage[]
  append: (message: CoreMessage | string) => Promise<void>
  reload: () => Promise<void>
  stop: () => void
  setMessages: (messages: CoreMessage[]) => void

  // Input state
  input: string
  setInput: (input: string) => void
  handleSubmit: (e?: React.FormEvent) => void
  handleInputChange: (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void

  // Loading/error state
  isLoading: boolean
  error: Error | null

  // Memory integration
  memory: MemoryContext | null
  memoryStats: MemoryStats | null

  // Tools integration
  tools: ToolDefinition[]
  pendingToolCalls: ToolCall[]
  executeToolCall: (toolCallId: string) => Promise<void>

  // Token optimization
  tokenStats: TokenStats | null

  // RAG integration
  ragContext: RAGContext | null

  // Safety
  safetyStats: SafetyStats | null

  // Meta information
  meta: {
    version: string
    preset: ClarityAppPreset
    features: ClarityFeatureFlags
  }
}
```

**Usage:**

```tsx
import { useClarityChatApp } from '@clarity-chat/react'

function ChatComponent() {
  const {
    messages,
    input,
    setInput,
    handleSubmit,
    isLoading,
    error,
    memory,
    tokenStats
  } = useClarityChatApp({
    api: '/api/chat',
    features: {
      memory: true,
      tokenOptimization: true,
      tools: true
    }
  })

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="messages">
        {messages.map(m => (
          <div key={m.id}>{m.content}</div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {error && <div className="error">{error.message}</div>}

      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
        <input
          value={input}
          onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)}
          disabled={isLoading}
        />
        <button type="submit" disabled={isLoading}>
          Send
        </button>
      </form>

      {tokenStats && (
        <div className="stats">
          Tokens: {tokenStats.totalTokens} | Cost: ${tokenStats.cost.total.toFixed(4)}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
```

---

### useClarityChat

**Path**: /reference/hooks/use-clarity-chat
**Package**: @clarity-chat/react

Primary hook for chat state management with memory integration and streaming support.

**Options:**

```typescript
interface UseClarityChatOptions {
  /** API endpoint URL */
  api: string

  /** Initial messages */
  initialMessages?: CoreMessage[]

  /** Memory configuration */
  memory?: {
    enabled?: boolean
    autoCapture?: boolean
    requireConsent?: boolean
    onConsentRequired?: () => Promise<boolean> | boolean
    strategy?: 'sliding-window' | 'semantic-chunks' | 'vector-store'
    maxTokens?: number
    retryOnError?: boolean
    maxRetryAttempts?: number
    onMemoryError?: (error: Error, operation: 'query' | 'store') => void
  }

  /** Transport protocol */
  transport?: 'sse' | 'websocket'

  /** WebSocket options */
  websocket?: {
    url?: string
    reconnect?: boolean
    maxReconnectAttempts?: number
    reconnectDelay?: number
  }

  /** Prompt optimization */
  promptOptimization?: {
    enabled?: boolean
    targetTokens?: number
    strategy?: 'sliding-window' | 'summarize-old' | 'drop-low-priority' | 'hybrid'
    model?: string
    priorities?: Array<{ messageId: string; priority: number }>
    summarizeFn?: (messages: CoreMessage[]) => Promise<string> | string
    keepRecent?: number
  }

  /** Custom headers */
  headers?: Record<string, string>

  /** Request body extras */
  body?: Record<string, unknown>

  /** Credentials mode */
  credentials?: RequestCredentials

  /** Streaming protocol */
  streamProtocol?: 'data' | 'text'

  /** Callbacks */
  onResponse?: (response: Response) => void
  onFinish?: (message: CoreMessage) => void
  onError?: (error: Error) => void
}
```

**Return Type:**

```typescript
interface UseClarityChatReturn {
  // Core state
  messages: CoreMessage[]
  append: (message: CoreMessage | string, options?: AppendOptions) => Promise<string | null | undefined>
  reload: (options?: ReloadOptions) => Promise<string | null | undefined>
  stop: () => void
  setMessages: (messages: CoreMessage[] | ((messages: CoreMessage[]) => CoreMessage[])) => void

  // Input state
  input: string
  setInput: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<string>>
  handleSubmit: (e?: React.FormEvent, options?: SubmitOptions) => void
  handleInputChange: (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement | HTMLInputElement>) => void

  // Status
  isLoading: boolean
  error: Error | undefined

  // Memory info
  memoryInfo: {
    memoryCount: number
    enabled: boolean
    strategy?: 'sliding-window' | 'semantic-chunks' | 'vector-store'
    lastContextSummary?: string
  }
  memoryErrorInfo: {
    hasError: boolean
    lastError?: Error
    failedOperation?: 'query' | 'store'
  }

  // Token stats (if prompt optimization enabled)
  tokenStats?: {
    inputTokens: number
    remainingBudget: number
    utilization: number
    lastOptimizationReason?: string
    wasOptimized: boolean
  }
}
```

**Usage:**

```tsx
import { useClarityChat } from '@clarity-chat/react'

function ChatInterface() {
  const {
    messages,
    input,
    setInput,
    handleSubmit,
    isLoading,
    error,
    memoryInfo,
    tokenStats
  } = useClarityChat({
    api: '/api/chat',
    memory: {
      enabled: true,
      strategy: 'vector-store',
      maxTokens: 8000
    },
    promptOptimization: {
      enabled: true,
      targetTokens: 4000,
      strategy: 'hybrid'
    }
  })

  return (
    <div className="chat-interface">
      {/* Messages */}
      <div className="messages">
        {messages.map(message => (
          <div key={message.id} className={`message ${message.role}`}>
            {message.content}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Error */}
      {error && (
        <div className="error">
          Error: {error.message}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Input */}
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
        <textarea
          value={input}
          onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Type a message..."
          disabled={isLoading}
        />
        <button type="submit" disabled={isLoading || !input.trim()}>
          {isLoading ? 'Sending...' : 'Send'}
        </button>
      </form>

      {/* Stats */}
      <div className="stats">
        {memoryInfo.enabled && (
          <span>Memory: {memoryInfo.memoryCount} items</span>
        )}
        {tokenStats && (
          <span>
            Tokens: {tokenStats.inputTokens} / {tokenStats.remainingBudget}
            ({Math.round(tokenStats.utilization * 100)}%)
          </span>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

---

## Memory Package

### clarityMemory

**Path**: /reference/packages/memory/clarity-memory
**Package**: @clarity-chat/memory

Zero-config memory factory function for quick setup.

**Usage:**

```typescript
import { clarityMemory } from '@clarity-chat/memory'

// Zero-config usage (uses in-memory storage)
const mem = clarityMemory()
await mem.add("User prefers TypeScript", { type: 'semantic', importance: 0.9 })
const results = await mem.recall("user preferences")

// With IndexedDB storage
const mem = clarityMemory({
  storage: { type: 'indexeddb', dbName: 'chat-memory' }
})

// With OpenAI embeddings
const mem = clarityMemory({
  storage: { type: 'indexeddb' },
  embeddingProvider: {
    provider: 'openai',
    apiKey: process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY,
    model: 'text-embedding-3-small'
  }
})

// Full configuration
const mem = clarityMemory({
  storage: { type: 'indexeddb', dbName: 'chat-memory' },
  embeddingProvider: {
    provider: 'openai',
    apiKey: process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY
  },
  decay: {
    policy: 'exponential',
    halfLife: 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000 // 7 days
  },
  tokenBudget: {
    maxTokens: 10000,
    warningThreshold: 0.8
  },
  consent: {
    required: true,
    purposes: ['memory', 'analytics']
  }
})
```

**API:**

```typescript
interface ClarityMemoryInstance {
  /** Add memory item */
  add: (content: string, metadata?: MemoryMetadata) => Promise<MemoryItem>

  /** Recall memories (semantic search) */
  recall: (query: string, options?: RecallOptions) => Promise<MemorySearchResult[]>

  /** Update memory item */
  update: (id: string, content: string, metadata?: MemoryMetadata) => Promise<MemoryItem>

  /** Delete memory item */
  delete: (id: string) => Promise<void>

  /** Clear all memories */
  clear: () => Promise<void>

  /** Get statistics */
  stats: () => Promise<MemoryStats>

  /** Export memories (GDPR compliance) */
  export: (options?: ExportOptions) => Promise<DataExportResult>

  /** Consent operations */
  consent: ConsentManager

  /** Audit logger */
  audit: AuditLogger
}
```

## Token Optimization Package

### useTokenOptimization

**Path**: /reference/hooks/use-token-optimization
**Package**: @clarity-chat/token-optimization

Unified token optimization hook with compression, caching, and routing.

**Usage:**

```typescript
import { useTokenOptimization } from '@clarity-chat/token-optimization'

function OptimizedChat() {
  const {
    count,
    estimate,
    optimize,
    cache,
    stats
  } = useTokenOptimization({
    model: 'gpt-4o',
    preset: 'balanced',
    caching: true,
    compression: true,
    compressionStrategy: 'llmlingua'
  })

  // Count tokens
  const tokens = count("Hello, world!")

  // Estimate with cost
  const est = estimate("Long text here...")
  console.log(`${est.tokens} tokens = $${est.cost.total}`)

  // Optimize text
  const result = optimize(longText, 1000)
  console.log(`Reduced from ${result.originalTokens} to ${result.optimizedTokens}`)

  // Use cache
  const cached = cache.get('prompt-key')
  if (!cached) {
    cache.set('prompt-key', response)
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <p>Total tokens: {stats.totalTokens}</p>
      <p>Savings: ${stats.savings.amount.toFixed(2)} ({Math.round(stats.savings.percentage)}%)</p>
    </div>
  )
}
```

## Guides

### Quick Start Guide

**Path**: /get-started/quick-start

Get a working chat interface in 5 minutes:

1. **Install the package:**
```bash
pnpm add @clarity-chat/react
```

2. **Create your API endpoint:**
```typescript
// app/api/chat/route.ts
import { streamText } from 'ai'
import { openai } from '@ai-sdk/openai'

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const { messages } = await req.json()

  const result = streamText({
    model: openai('gpt-4o'),
    messages
  })

  return result.toDataStreamResponse()
}
```

3. **Add the chat component:**
```tsx
import { ClarityChatApp } from '@clarity-chat/react'

export default function Page() {
  return <ClarityChatApp api="/api/chat" />
}
```

That's it! You now have a fully functional chat interface.

---

### Token Optimization Guide

**Path**: /guides/token-optimization

Reduce API costs by 50-70% with built-in optimization.

**Basic Setup:**

```tsx
import { ClarityChatApp } from '@clarity-chat/react'

<ClarityChatApp
  api="/api/chat"
  features={{ tokenOptimization: true }}
  tokenOptimization={{
    enabled: true,
    strategies: ['compression', 'caching', 'routing']
  }}
/>
```

**Strategies:**

1. **Compression** - Reduce token count while preserving meaning
2. **Caching** - Reuse responses for similar queries
3. **Routing** - Use smaller models for simple tasks

**Advanced Configuration:**

```tsx
tokenOptimization={{
  compression: {
    strategy: 'llmlingua',
    targetRatio: 0.5 // 50% reduction
  },
  caching: {
    tiers: [
      { name: 'exact', ttl: 60000 },
      { name: 'semantic', similarity: 0.85 }
    ]
  },
  routing: {
    strategy: 'cost-optimized',
    models: {
      simple: 'gpt-4o-mini',
      complex: 'gpt-4o'
    }
  }
}}
```

---

## Cookbook Recipes

### Achieving 50-70% Cost Reduction

**Path**: /cookbook/achieving-50-percent-reduction

Complete guide to reducing API costs with combined strategies.

```tsx
import { ClarityChatApp } from '@clarity-chat/react'

export default function OptimizedChat() {
  return (
    <ClarityChatApp
      api="/api/chat"
      features={{
        memory: true,
        tokenOptimization: true
      }}
      memory={{
        strategy: 'vector-store',
        maxTokens: 8000
      }}
      tokenOptimization={{
        compression: {
          enabled: true,
          strategy: 'llmlingua',
          targetRatio: 0.5
        },
        caching: {
          enabled: true,
          tiers: [
            { name: 'exact', maxSize: 1000, ttl: 60000 },
            { name: 'semantic', maxSize: 500, similarity: 0.85 }
          ]
        },
        routing: {
          enabled: true,
          strategy: 'cost-optimized'
        }
      }}
    />
  )
}
```

**Results:**
- 50-60% reduction from compression
- 20-30% reduction from caching
- 10-20% reduction from routing
- **Total: 50-70% cost reduction**

## Types

### Core Message Types

```typescript
interface CoreMessage {
  id: string
  role: 'user' | 'assistant' | 'system' | 'tool'
  content: string | MessageContent[]
  createdAt?: Date
  name?: string
  toolInvocations?: ToolInvocation[]
}

type MessageContent =
  | { type: 'text'; text: string }
  | { type: 'image'; image: string | URL }
  | { type: 'file'; file: File | Blob }

interface ToolInvocation {
  toolCallId: string
  toolName: string
  args: Record<string, unknown>
  result?: unknown
  state: 'pending' | 'running' | 'completed' | 'error'
}
```

### Memory Types

```typescript
interface MemoryItem {
  id: string
  content: string
  type: MemoryType
  scope: MemoryScope
  priority: MemoryPriority
  importance: number
  embedding?: number[]
  metadata: MemoryMetadata
  createdAt: Date
  updatedAt: Date
  accessCount: number
  lastAccessedAt: Date
}

type MemoryType = 'semantic' | 'episodic' | 'procedural' | 'working'
type MemoryScope = 'session' | 'conversation' | 'user' | 'global'
type MemoryPriority = 'critical' | 'high' | 'medium' | 'low'
```

## AI-Optimized APIs

### REST Endpoints

- `GET /api/ai/components` - All component documentation (JSON)
- `GET /api/ai/hooks` - All hook documentation (JSON)
- `GET /api/ai/search?q={query}` - Full-text search
- `GET /api/ai/health` - API health status
- `GET /openapi.json` - OpenAPI 3.0 specification

### MCP Server

Model Context Protocol server for Claude Code and other AI tools.

**Configuration:**
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "clarity-chat": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["tsx", "apps/streamlined-docs/mcp-server/index.ts"]
    }
  }
}
```

**Available Tools:**
- `list_components` - List all components
- `get_component(name)` - Get component documentation
- `list_hooks` - List all hooks
- `get_hook(name)` - Get hook documentation
- `search_docs(query)` - Search documentation
- `health_check` - Check API health
